purpose: Ask the user missing details in the app's question UI.
Measure an uploaded/fetched image: size, orientation, dominant colours, brightness, background uniformity, transparency. The LLM NEVER guesses these; it reads the facts.
Find real web photos via the Visual A-Z image search endpoint (POST /api/google-scrape-images).
Download a candidate through the image proxy, optionally remove the background, adjust (brightness/contrast/saturation/crop/resize) and return a PNG dataURL.
Static checks on generated HTML (size, no scripts, no external resources, placeholders, fonts, contrast hints).
Render final HTML at full size inside a sandboxed iframe, scale down into the small chat box; export PNG on download.
